questions.q: I’ve never been to REAPS. Can I try a regular Main meeting for free, and where do I get the guest pass?
questions.theirs: The guest-pass page covers one free visit to a regular Main meeting. The December 1 Bellevue Coffee event lists Woods Coffee from 8:30 to 10:30 a.m. and $20 for nonmembers. This is a separate subgroup event.
questions.ours:
Yes. First-time guests can attend one regular monthly Main meeting free with a guest pass. The pass is limited to one per person and doesn’t apply to subgroup events.

Get yours through the [REAPS guest pass form](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107694&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=R3OxycakOFvq&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.reapsweb.com%2FGuestPass.aspx).

**Visitor:** Actually, I want to go to the December 1 Bellevue Coffee as a nonmember. Will that pass work there, and what should I plan for?

**Subsights:** No—the free guest pass applies only to a regular Main meeting, not the Bellevue Coffee subgroup.

For **Tuesday, December 1, 2026**, plan for:

- **Time:** 8:30–10:30 a.m. Pacific
- **Location:** Woods Coffee, 625 116th Ave NE, Bellevue
- **Nonmember price:** $20

See the [Bellevue Coffee Conversations event listing](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107696&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=R3OxycakOFvq&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.reapsweb.com%2FEvents.aspx%3FID%3DCoffee-Conversations-Focused-on-REI-213-12-1-2026) for the event details. Live availability isn’t confirmed here.
questions.outcome: The answer keeps the first-time offer for a Main meeting, drops it for the Bellevue subgroup and gives the correct time, venue and $20 nonmember price.

questions.q: I mostly want online REAPS meetings for myself. What does online-only membership cost, and does it include in-person meetings?
questions.theirs: The membership page lists the $99 annual online-only membership without in-person access. Its Platinum benefits say six people while the product rows say four. REAPS has a separate contact page.
questions.ours:
The **online-only individual membership costs $99 per year**. It does **not** include in-person meetings.

[View REAPS membership options](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107701&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=R3OxycakOFvq&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.reapsweb.com%2FMembershipInfo.aspx)

**Visitor:** Actually, there would be five coworkers and we all want to go in person. Can we buy one Platinum membership for all five?

**Subsights:** **It’s unclear whether one Platinum membership covers all five.** REAPS’ Platinum benefits say six people, but its product rows say four.

Please [confirm the Platinum seat limit with REAPS](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107705&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=R3OxycakOFvq&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.reapsweb.com%2FContact.aspx) before paying.
questions.outcome: The answer identifies the conflict and routes the five-person group to REAPS before purchase.
